attacks.name: Braid Bash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Push it |!range_small|.
|!critical| |!wild| |*Flurry|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make a |*Braid Bash| attack. This additional attack does not have the |*Flurry| special rule.

attacks.name: Split Ends
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, Place it within |!range| 1 of this character.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

superPowers.name: Hair Flip
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character of |!size| 3 or less and within |!range| 3 and Throw it |!range_small|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Royal Decree
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 2 of this character. Place this character within |!range| 1 of the chosen character or Place the chosen character within |!range| 1 of this character. A character may be Placed by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Inhuman
superPowers.body: This character may reroll 1 die in its attack or defense rolls.

superPowers.name: Living Strands
superPowers.body: When Advancing or Climbing, enemy characters cannot Place the movement tool overlapping this character's base. Additionally, enemy characters cannot modify attack dice when targeting this character with attacks.

erratas.body: Braid Bash's Flurry now requires |!critical| and |!wild| to trigger, instead of |!wild|.
Braid Bash's push now triggers on a |!wild| and occurs before |!damage| is dealt, instead of occuring after the attack is resolved if at least 1 |!damage| was dealt.
